name: Webex
label: Webex — Webex REST API v1
description: Webex via the official Webex REST API v1. Base https://webexapis.com/v1. Docs: https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/messages. Bot vs user tokens differ (bots cannot list all rooms). listen = Webex webhooks as BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Webex operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"create-message"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: create-message | get-message | list-messages | update-message | delete-message | create-meeting | get-meeting | list-meetings | update-meeting | delete-meeting | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: roomId
schema.description: Space id. create-message / list-messages / update-message. Example: Y2lzY29zcGFyazovL3VzL1JPT00v…

schema.label: messageId
schema.description: Message id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: meetingId
schema.description: Meeting id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Plain text. create-message / update-message. Required unless markdown or files is set.

schema.label: toPersonEmail
schema.description: Direct 1:1 by email when roomId omitted. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: markdown
schema.description: Request-body parameter `markdown` for operations: create-message, update-message.

schema.label: max
schema.description: Query-string parameter `max` for operations: list-messages, list-meetings.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Meeting title, required by create-meeting (also update-meeting). Example: Weekly sync.

schema.label: start
schema.description: Meeting start, ISO 8601 date-time, required by create-meeting (also update-meeting). Example: 2026-12-01T10:00:00Z.

schema.label: end
schema.description: Meeting end, ISO 8601 date-time after start, required by create-meeting (also update-meeting). Example: 2026-12-01T11:00:00Z.

schema.label: files
schema.description: Public file URLs for create-message. Example: ["https://example.com/a.png"]. https://developer.webex.com/docs/api/v1/messages/create-a-message

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: create-message, get-message, list-messages, update-message, delete-message, create-meeting, get-meeting, list-meetings, update-meeting, delete-meeting, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Webex token
configurationParameters.description: Webex bot token or OAuth user token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
